avoid.flag: 4K and 100-day battery claims, unnamed app, cloud is a trial
avoid.verdict: It promises 4K and 100 days on a battery for $29.98, but never names its app and offers only a cloud storage trial.
reasons: The listing never names the app you'd install to view the camera.
The "free cloud storage" is described as a trial.
It claims 4K and up to 100 days of battery without any sensor or bitrate details to back it up.
The power adapter isn't included, per the listing.
avoid.name: Funstorm 2025 Upgraded Security Camera, 4K HD Mini Nanny Cam for Home with Night Vision, WiFi Indoor Camera, 100 Days Long Battery Life, Motion Detection, Remote Viewing, Wireless Surveillance Cam

buyers_guide.a: Many cameras store clips in the cloud only with a monthly plan. Others record to a microSD card or a base station for free. Check what the free tier includes before you buy several.
Battery cameras go anywhere but sleep between events, so they can miss the first second of motion and need recharging. Wired cameras record continuously and react faster but need an outlet nearby.
Most cameras use 2.4 GHz, which reaches farther through walls. Some newer ones support 5 GHz for faster streaming close to the router.
